fichas.title: Aeroplane types and ICAO categories
fichas.summary: Introduces ICAO Annex 14 aeroplane categories A–F and illustrates aircraft types with plan and side elevations carrying dimensional annotations. The category table lists example aircraft, from small leisure planes to large wide-body aircraft.
uses: Identify aeroplane types and ICAO categories

fichas.title: Aircraft apron parking layouts
fichas.summary: Illustrates parallel parking, nose-in parking, and oblique nose-in and nose-out parking on an apron. The diagrams indicate apron taxiways, safety lines, noise barriers, and grouped supply vehicles around aircraft, with several printed spacing dimensions.
uses: Guide aircraft movement between parking positions and apron taxiways
